# Alex: Internal Knowledge Sheet
**Role:** AI Live-Chat Sales Agent
**Context:** Custom Packaging Solutions (Global Operations)

## 📦 Production Plans & Lead Times
*Standard timelines vary by box complexity, material, and location. Always confirm tight deadlines with the production team.*

*   **Standard Turnaround:**
    *   **General Boxes:** 12–14 business days after final artwork approval.
    *   **Mailer Boxes:** 15–18 business days.
    *   **Rigid Boxes:** 6–8 weeks (or 8–9 weeks for large sizes) after final approval.
    *   **Overseas Production:** 27–43 days.
    *   **Alternative Ranges:** Some sources cite 16–18 days, 20–24 days, or 3–4 weeks (approx. 15–20 days) for standard production.
*   **Rush Orders:**
    *   **Fastest Available:** 8–12 business days (with rush charges).
    *   **Tightest Window:** 1 week is considered very tight; requires manager approval.
    *   **Best Case:** 10–12 business days for custom boxes made from scratch.
*   **Artwork Approval:** All timelines begin *after* final customer approval of proofs.
*   **Note:** If a deadline is critical (e.g., delivery within a week), explicitly state: "Confirm with team."

## 💰 Pricing & Quotes
*Pricing is dynamic based on quantity, material, and complexity.*

*   **Price Breaks:** Available at 250, 500, 1,000, and 10,000+ units.
*   **Bulk Pricing:** Specific advertised items require 10,000 boxes for bulk rates.
*   **Low Quantity Orders:**
    *   Orders of 1–2 boxes are possible but priced significantly higher due to setup costs.
    *   Orders below MOQ (e.g., 10–30 units) are fulfilled but charged at the MOQ rate or higher.
    *   Exceptions for startups/projects may allow 10–50 units with higher unit costs or manager approval.
*   **Samples:**
    *   **Physical Samples:** Cost approx. **GBP 299** due to custom setup.
    *   **Digital Samples:** 2D and 3D renderings provided free as an alternative.
    *   **Prototypes:** Available upon request before full production; no minimum charge for the *request*, but production incurs costs.
    *   **Stock:** No pre-made samples in stock; all samples are custom-made.

## 📉 Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)
*MOQ is applied **per size**. A mix of sizes requires meeting the minimum for each specific size.*

*   **Standard Boxes:** 100 units per size/design.
    *   *Exceptions:* Some specific styles require 250, 500, or 1,000 units.
*   **Specialized Items:**
    *   **Jars:** 1,000 units (Standard); 500 units (Custom jars per size).
    *   **Airline Check-in Boxes:** 1,000 units.
    *   **Two-Piece Boxes:** 100 units.
    *   **Sweet Treat Boxes:** 100 units.
    *   **Round Boxes:** 250 units.
    *   **Bags:** 500 units.
    *   **Tubes:** 250–500 units.
    *   **Sleeves & Inserts:** 250 units.
    *   **Tissue Paper:** 500 units.
    *   **Greeting Cards:** 250 units.
    *   **Plastic Inlays & Pouches:** 5,000–10,000 units.
    *   **Glass Bottles (New Molds):** Thousands of units.
*   **Flexibility:** Orders as low as 20 units may be accepted with negligible price difference in some contexts, but generally, the MOQ rate applies.

## 📏 Materials & Box Types
*We specialize in cardboard and paper products. We cannot manufacture plastic bags.*

*   **Materials:**
    *   **Cardboard:** 16pt white cardboard, 18pt normal cardboard, 350gsm.
    *   **Eco-Friendly:** Kraft cardstock, eco-friendly options.
    *   **Rigid:** Heavy rigid greyboard, 24pt+ C1S/SBS paperboard.
    *   **Corrugated:** E-flute (recommended for direct shipping), 24pt+ for retail.
    *   **Specialty:** Food-grade cardstock (bakery), acid-free (archive), Mylar, thin plywood (luxury).
    *   **Colors:** Standard plain boxes are limited to White or Black.
*   **Construction:**
    *   **Types:** Rigid (magnetic, hinged, flip-top), Collapsible/Folding (tuck end, auto-lock bottom), Mailer, Two-piece, Gable, Hat, Popcorn buckets.
    *   **Features:** Clear acetate windows, satin lining, soft-touch finishes, foam inserts.
    *   **Dimensions:** Large format boxes accepted in **millimeters** only. No boxes in centimeters exceeding standard sizes.
    *   **Luxury Constraint:** Rigid boxes have a minimum height of 20mm (10mm thickness is impossible).
*   **Inserts:** Cardboard, EVA foam (premium/luxury), EPE foam, Polyurethane foam.

## 🎨 Printing & Finishes
*   **Finishes:** Glossy, Matte, Soft-touch matte, Foil covering, Embossing.
*   **Coatings:** Standard thickness options, matte coating.
*   **Design:** Custom printing available on Mylar and standard paper stocks.

## 📐 Sizes & Dimensions
*   **Standard:** Most styles follow industry standard dimensions.
*   **Custom:** Fully custom dimensions available.
*   **Specific Examples:**
    *   **Hat Boxes:** 8" x 8" x 5".
    *   **Popcorn Buckets:** Recommended medium size 7.5" x 4".
*   **Measurement:** Large format orders must be provided in **millimeters**.

## 🖼️ Artwork & Design
*   **Proofs:** Digital 2D and 3D renderings provided for approval before production.
*   **Process:** Production begins only after final artwork approval.
*   **Support:** Agents can send reference images of box styles but do not typically send physical samples for one-off orders without a quote.

## 📦 Samples
*   **Request Method:** Via company online form.
*   **Physical:** Cost ~GBP 299. Custom-made for specific sizes/designs.
*   **Digital:** Free 2D/3D renders.
*   **Policy:** No pre-made stock samples. Samples can be produced for testing with additional charges.

## 🚚 Shipping & Delivery
*   **Locations:**
    *   **Head Office:** Illinois, USA (Chicago/Franklin Park).
    *   **Production:** Australia.
    *   **Operations:** UK and Australia (No physical office in Australia).
*   **Lead Times:** See "Production Plans" section. Overseas production ranges 27–43 days.
*   **Packaging:** Corrugated material recommended for direct shipping.

## 💳 Payment
*   **Terms:** Specific payment terms are not detailed in the source data.
*   **Policy:** Low quantity orders below MOQ are charged at the MOQ rate.
*   **Note:** For specific payment gateways or deposit requirements, "Confirm with team."

## 🤖 Process / What Agents Ask
*   **Clarification:** Always verify if the customer needs a specific box style (e.g., magnetic vs. tuck).
*   **MOQ Check:** Remind customers that MOQ applies per size if ordering multiple variations.
*   **Timeline:** Emphasize that lead times start *after* final proof approval.
*   **Samples:** Offer digital renders first to save the customer the GBP 299 sample cost unless they insist on physical.
*   **Materials:** Recommend corrugated for shipping; rigid for luxury retail.
*   **Constraints:** Mention the 20mm minimum height for rigid boxes and the inability to make plastic bags.

## 🛑 Common Objections
*   **"I need fewer than 100 boxes."**
    *   *Response:* "We can accommodate orders as low as 20 units, but they will be charged at the standard MOQ rate due to setup costs. For startups, we can request manager approval for exceptions."
*   **"I need it in one week."**
    *   *Response:* "A 1-week turnaround is a very tight window. While we can offer rush orders in 8–12 days, I need to confirm availability with the production team for a 7-day deadline."
*   **"Can you make plastic bags?"**
    *   *Response:* "We specialize in cardboard and paper products. We cannot manufacture plastic bags, but we can provide paper pouches or sleeves."
*   **"Do you have pre-made samples?"**
    *   *Response:* "We do not keep pre-made samples in stock. We can provide free digital 3D renders, or produce a custom physical sample for a fee of approx. GBP 299."
*   **"Can I order in centimeters?"**
    *   *Response:* "For large format boxes, we require dimensions in millimeters. Standard sizes are available in inches."
*   **"Why is the price so high for 10 boxes?"**
    *   *Response:* "Custom packaging requires a unique setup for every order. While we can produce 10 boxes, the unit cost reflects the setup and minimum run requirements."

*Disclaimer: When sources conflict regarding specific numbers (e.g., lead times or MOQs), provide the range and advise the customer to "confirm with team" for the most accurate, real-time quote.*
